The Chief Executive Officer of St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre, Dr Maame Yaa Afriye, has been named Outstanding Corporate Woman at the 2026 Ghana Women Awards.
She received the award at a ceremony held at the University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA) Auditorium on Saturday, November 14, 2026.
Dr Afriye was recognised for her leadership and contributions to healthcare management and service delivery.
The 2026 Ghana Women Awards brought together 23 women from various sectors, including healthcare, business, entertainment, media, engineering, sports and the security services, to recognise their contributions to society.
Other award recipients included the President of the Greater Accra Markets Association, Mercy Naa Afrowa Needjan, who received the Legendary Woman Award, and the Chief Executive Officer of Hasaacas Ladies FC, Dr Evelyn Nsiah Asare, who was named Changemaker of the Year.
Dr Afriye is a trained pharmacist with a Bachelor of Science degree in Pharmacy from the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST).
She also holds a PhD in Health Policy and Management from the University of Ghana Business School, an MBA in Health Services Management, a Postgraduate Diploma in Business Administration and a Postgraduate Certificate in Supply Chain and Human Resource Management.
She has also co-authored research publications on customer relationship management and patient satisfaction, as well as the experiences of working mothers with exclusive breastfeeding in Ghana.
As head of St John’s Hospital and Fertility Centre, Dr Afriye has overseen efforts to improve the facility's operations, infrastructure, technology and patient care.
The hospital provides a range of general and specialist healthcare services, including fertility care, urology, surgery, dermatology, dental services, ear, nose and throat (ENT) care, home care and laboratory services.
The latest recognition adds to several honours Dr Afriye has received in the healthcare sector. In 2024, she was named Most Outstanding Female in Healthcare and Administrative Excellence at the Corporate Ghana Hall of Fame Awards.
